newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens, partner win 2 bln DM power deal.
newsitem.headline: Siemens, partner win 2 bln DM power deal.

text.p: German industrial group Siemens AG said on Wednesday it and a partner won a two billion mark ($1.2 billion) contract to build a power plant in Taiwan.
Siemens and Huatung Power Co. would build a coal-fired plant with a performance of 500 megawatts, Siemens said. ($ = 1.731 German Marks)
The plant would be located in Hualien province.
The partners were also awaiting decisions on two additional plants at other locations.
For the Hualien contract, Siemens' KWU power generation unit would construct a turnkey plant and share in operating the facility.
In the six months that ended March 31, KWU reported sales fell 28 percent to 2.4 billion marks, while orders fell 20 percent to four billion marks.
